account.question: Do I need an account to analyse games?
account.answer: No. You can analyse games and use the local Archive without creating an account. An account is only needed for optional synchronisation across devices.

archive.question: Where are my analyses saved?
archive.answer: Guest analyses are stored in the current browser. When you sign in, compatible data can also be associated with your account for cross-device access.

engine.question: What is NexoChess and which chess engine does it use?
engine.answer: NexoChess is a free chess game analyser. It uses Stockfish 17 to evaluate positions, identify mistakes and produce the engine lines used in the review.

languages.question: How is the language selected?
languages.answer: On the first visit, NexoChess follows your browser language when it is supported. You can change it manually at any time in Appearance settings.

privacy.question: Is an account required to keep my local games?
privacy.answer: No. The local Archive works without an account. Signing in is optional and is intended for synchronisation and account features.
